About.label: About
About.title: Long story short
About.intro: I came to IT in 2022 after 18 years of very different work: kitchens in Kharkiv, warehouse logistics and sales in Prague. Running a kitchen and a sales team taught me what product work needs most — deadlines, processes and talking to people. Since 2023 I’ve been building commercial React and React Native products, and now I’m growing into full-stack.
